metaDescription: Meethaq brings the contract, delivery and payment into one track, so no milestone's payment is released until it's accepted.

hero.eyebrow: Your work deserves a clear track
hero.subtitle: Meethaq brings the contract, conversation, delivery and payment into one track, so no milestone's payment is released until it's accepted.
hero.illustrationAlt: Illustration of signing an agreement on Meethaq

shift.title: It's agreements scattered everywhere.
shift.subtitle: A message here, a file there, a transfer with no record. Every new tool loses a piece of the project's context, until proving what was agreed is harder than doing the work itself.

flow.title: Five steps, from agreement to payment
flow.illustrationAlt: Illustration of the steps of working on Meethaq

create.title: Create the client and project
create.description: A simple client profile and a dedicated project space.

agree.title: Agree on the milestones
agree.description: Scope, deadline, acceptance criteria and value for each milestone, approved by both sides.

deliver.title: Deliver each milestone
deliver.description: Delivery files or links attached directly to their milestone.

accept.title: The client reviews the delivery
accept.description: Acceptance or a specific revision request, with every decision recorded and dated.

release.title: The payment becomes due
release.description: As soon as it's accepted, the milestone's value becomes eligible for payment.

contract.title: Milestone-based contract
contract.description: Every milestone has a scope, deadline, acceptance criteria and value from day one, so there's no confusion later about what was agreed.

delivery.title: Documented delivery
delivery.description: Every file, link or reply to a revision request is logged with its date and author, building a clear record for each milestone.

payment.title: Payment tied to acceptance
payment.description: A milestone's value is only released once the client actually accepts it: no payment before the work, and no work without payment.

record.title: A record that holds up
record.description: If a dispute comes up, the full timeline of the agreement, deliveries and decisions is ready, instead of digging through scattered chats.

memory.title: Not just a contract. A trusted memory of the project.
memory.subtitle: Meethaq doesn't add another tool to the pile. It connects the moments that matter, so each side knows what happened, when, and what comes next.
memory.note: Built to keep the project's context, not to replace human conversation.

clarity.title: Clarity before you start
clarity.description: Scope, deadline, value and acceptance criteria are written down from the start.

approval.title: Approval with no room for doubt
approval.description: Every delivery and approval is tied to its milestone, on a clear timeline.

payment.title: Payment follows the work
payment.description: Each milestone's value is released only once it's approved, as both sides agreed.

closing.title: Clearer agreements. Calmer work. Secured rights.
closing.subtitle: Create your first project, split it into milestones, and start with your client from a point that's clear to everyone.
